answer.reason: Only 2 Chronicles 16:7-9 tells a deed of Hanani himself, his rebuke of Asa; the other verses only name him as Jehu's father.

clauses.english: rebuked King Asa for relying on the king of Syria and not on the LORD
clauses.quote: Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria, and not relied on the LORD

doubts: 1KI 16:1, 1KI 16:7, 2CH 19:2 and 2CH 20:34 only name Hanani as Jehu's father, so they were not used for a clause.
